## Overview

This starter project describes a reusable workflow for choice modelling research, from raw survey data through model estimation and reporting.

## Research Question

How can a choice experiment workflow be structured so that data cleaning, model estimation, willingness-to-pay calculations, and reporting remain transparent and reproducible?

## Methods

- Define a clear data dictionary and survey structure.
- Prepare choice tasks and respondent-level covariates.
- Estimate baseline and heterogeneity-focused models.
- Report model fit, parameter signs, uncertainty, and willingness-to-pay measures.

## Reporting

Each estimated model is reported with the same set of diagnostics so that
specifications stay comparable:

- Sample and choice-task counts, and any exclusions applied.
- Log-likelihood, number of parameters, and information criteria.
- Parameter estimates with standard errors, and the expected sign of each.
- Willingness-to-pay measures derived from the cost coefficient, with
  uncertainty carried through rather than reported as point estimates.

## Status

This page documents the workflow itself rather than a completed study. Code and
estimation output are not yet public; links to a repository and a worked example
will be added here as individual projects reach a shareable state.
